_source: Synced 2026-08-27 to designed identity (forest #166534). Live CSS: client/app/globals.css.

canonical_primary.note: Designed identity forest green. Used for --primary (light), theme_color, charts/certificates/emails. Dark mode --primary is brighter toward #22C55E. Logo is PNG from design masters, not a flat fill of this hex.

secondary.note: re-tuned 2026-08-26 (was 0.56/#946d00 for one day) — see contrast_fixes_2026-08-26_round4

success-foreground.note: added 2026-08-26 — text-success-foreground was used on solid bg-success badges with no variable previously defined

warning-foreground.note: added 2026-08-26 — bg-warning was paired with hardcoded text-white in several components (invisible text)

primary.note: brighter brand green for dark surfaces

_formerly_conflicting_greens_resolved_20.css-token-primary-light-was: #004b00 (an OKLCH gamut-clipping artifact at L=0.35 — not a deliberate 'very dark green' choice; see resolution log)
_formerly_conflicting_greens_resolved_20.favicon-and-app-icons-were: #1baf51 (generator read a separate, drifted copy of the icon SVG)
_formerly_conflicting_greens_resolved_20.logo-mark-gradient-was: #2d5a3d to #1e3d2a (two-stop gradient, plus unrelated blue/QR accent colors)

contrast_fixes_2026-08-25_round3.method: Computed WCAG contrast ratios (not eyeballed) for every token used as literal text/icon color, grounded in real usage counts via grep, not assumption. Each fix kept the token's original hue/chroma exactly and only adjusted lightness, the same pattern as the primary-color fix.
contrast_fixes_2026-08-25_round3.secondary-light: was 2.23:1 vs white (fails AA; text-secondary used in 12 files, and bg-secondary text-white buttons had literally invisible text) -> darkened to 4.72:1 -> re-tuned again in round 4, see below
contrast_fixes_2026-08-25_round3.warning-light: was 2.70:1 vs white (fails AA; text-warning used in 79 files, same invisible-white-text-on-badge bug) -> now 4.69:1
contrast_fixes_2026-08-25_round3.success-dark: was 2.73-2.95:1 vs dark background (fails AA; text-success used in 100 files) -> now 4.56:1
contrast_fixes_2026-08-25_round3.accent-dark_deliberately_unchanged: text-accent (standalone text, 44 files) wants a lighter value for contrast against the dark page background, but --accent is also the fill half of shadcn's own bg-accent/text-accent-foreground selection-state pattern (menus, calendar, command palette) — lightening it to fix the text case dropped that pairing's contrast from 3.97:1 to 3.22:1, i.e. traded a smaller problem for a bigger one. Left as-is; documented rather than forced through the same fix.

contrast_fixes_2026-08-26_round4.method: Round 3 fixed contrast by computation alone, without ever looking at the rendered result. Round 4 was a visual QA pass (Playwright screenshots of the actual running app, light and dark) that caught a real regression the math had missed.
contrast_fixes_2026-08-26_round4.secondary-light_re-tuned: Round 3's 0.56 (#946d00) passed WCAG math but rendered as a muddy dark-olive color in the dominant real use case — solid Badge fills (bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground), which never needed the darkening since that pairing was always fine (8.82:1 even at the original 0.75). The actual bug (bg-secondary text-white, invisible text) is now fixed at the 6 component call sites directly (swapped to text-secondary-foreground) instead of via the shared token. With that fixed separately, --secondary only needs to satisfy the smaller-stakes standalone-text case (text-secondary/fill-secondary, star ratings and small labels) — re-tuned to 0.64 (#ad8522, 3.41:1 vs white), clearing the 3:1 UI-component bar with margin while reading as gold again, not brown.
contrast_fixes_2026-08-26_round4.warning-foreground_and_success-foregroun: bg-warning and bg-success were being paired with hardcoded text-white (warning) or text-success-foreground with no variable defined (success) in several components — both invisible-text bugs. Added --warning-foreground and --success-foreground tokens and fixed the ~10 component call sites to use them instead of hardcoded/undefined classes.
contrast_fixes_2026-08-26_round4.agricultural-pattern_fixed: The .agricultural-pattern decorative background (used on the hero, auth, and profile-hero surfaces) had hardcoded rgba(22,163,74,...) and rgba(255,215,0,...) — the old drifted favicon green and an unrelated pure-gold, neither connected to any token. Only found by looking at the rendered page; a token/text grep would never have caught a raw rgba() in a CSS class. Recolored to the canonical green/gold and reduced density slightly (100px tiles -> 160px, 0.05 opacity -> 0.04) since the original read as a busy checkerboard rather than a subtle texture.

sans.role: body / UI default, H3 and smaller headings

serif.role: H1/H2 display headings only — fixed 2026-08-25, was incorrectly Nunito (a sans-serif); see audit finding #2
